rules.title: The midnight observation
rules.template: At midnight, {attributes.character} turns the telescope toward the dark. The instrument gathers a patient light from beyond the world.

rules.title: A storm on Jupiter
rules.template: Across Jupiter, a storm wider than Earth turns without rest. {attributes.character} traces its edge and wonders what keeps it alive.

rules.title: Weather at the window
rules.template: Rain threads the glass while the telescope waits indoors. Every drop briefly becomes a small, inverted sky.

rules.title: The reflected moon
rules.template: The moon lays a broken road across the ocean. {attributes.character} follows it with their eyes, not their feet.

rules.title: A brief architecture
rules.template: Lightning redraws every shadow in a single white instant, revealing a landscape that vanishes before it can be named.

rules.title: The weight of worlds
rules.template: Jupiter bends the paths around it. The equations say gravity; the night offers something closer to devotion.

rules.title: A useful uncertainty
rules.template: {attributes.character} writes the question in the margin and leaves the answer blank. Inquiry, for now, is enough.

rules.title: The hour turns
rules.template: The clock crosses midnight with a small mechanical click. Somewhere, a day ends without asking permission.

rules.title: A white summit
rules.template: Snow settles along the mountain's ridgeline, softening its oldest angles but not its height.

rules.title: The forest listens
rules.template: Wind moves through the forest canopy. The trees answer in a language older than weather reports.

rules.title: What remains
rules.template: In the silence, a memory returns without its edges. {attributes.character} lets it stay unfinished.

rules.title: A message in transit
rules.template: A signal crosses the distance at the speed of light. Its sender is gone; its arrival is now.

rules.title: Opposing elements
rules.template: Rain hisses against the fire. For one moment, making and unmaking share the same breath.

rules.title: The open threshold
rules.template: The door stands open onto no visible room. The question is no longer what is behind it, but who will cross.

rules.title: A moving home
rules.template: Earth circles its star, carrying oceans, forests, and every unfinished thought through the dark.

rules.title: Weather without flame
rules.template: The storm gathers its force without flame. The sky can be fierce and still leave the ground untouched.

rules.title: The act of looking
rules.template: A star is already old by the time its light arrives. Still, {attributes.character} looks up and calls it present.

rules.title: Rain in the quiet
rules.template: Rain finds its own rhythm against the quiet. Nothing speaks, and yet the room feels less empty.

rules.title: The borrowed shadow
rules.template: Moonlight gives the shadows room to stretch. By morning, they will pretend they were never there.

rules.title: A world begins
rules.template: A new detail enters {attributes.setting}. The world shifts, just enough to make room for it.
